# Tokenomics

> Tokenomics is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted real-time dashboard that shows how many tokens and how much money AI coding tools save you. It tracks Claude Code quota (5-hour session and weekly limits), Cursor usage, Google Antigravity quota, and token savings from RTK (Rust Token Killer), Headroom and Caveman, with per-model cost math (raw vs real vs saved USD, including prompt-cache pricing). Zero runtime dependencies: Node.js >= 18 built-ins only.

Key facts:

- Runs locally on http://localhost:3000; data never leaves your machine.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phil288/tokenomics/main/install.sh | sh`, or `git clone https://github.com/phil288/tokenomics.git && cd tokenomics && node server.js`.
- Live updates over Server-Sent Events, time-series history, quota pacing ("how much may I still use today"), optional desktop alerts.
- Supported model pricing: Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini / Antigravity, Cursor models. OpenAI / Codex not yet supported.
- Linux (systemd user service) and macOS (launchd) service installers included.

## Related tools

- [RTK — Rust Token Killer](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk): CLI proxy that compresses command output for LLM agents
- [Headroom](https://pypi.org/project/headroom-ai/): context optimization proxy (`pipx install headroom-ai`)
